# ColdCoupons

> ColdCoupons (https://coldcoupons.shop/) is an online directory of hand-tested, verified free game codes, digital promo codes, and in-game rewards covering 100+ gaming brands and 322+ active offers.

ColdCoupons verifies promotional codes daily so players can claim working rewards for PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Roblox, and mobile games without registration fees.

## Key Facts & Statistics
- **Brand Name:** ColdCoupons
- **Primary URL:** https://coldcoupons.shop/
- **Active Verified Codes:** 322+ hand-tested promo and game codes
- **Covered Gaming Brands:** 100+ brands and categories
- **Verification Frequency:** Daily manual and automated testing (98.4% working rate)
- **Cost to Users:** 100% free, no account registration required
